name: Schieder-Schwalenberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over red, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Schieder-Schwalenberg (a swallow on a yellow star on red beside a crown on blue).
history: The arms show in red a natural swallow on a gold eight-pointed star and in blue a gold crown; by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 14 April 1972 the city was granted the right to bear them.

features.role: Schieder-Schwalenberg arms — swallow on star and crown
